annotations.title: Prepare my CaseBrief for a lawyer conversation (nothing is saved)

description: Use when the person wants to get ready to talk to a lawyer about their own matter, e.g. "help me organize my eviction case before I call a lawyer" or "what should I bring to a consultation about unpaid overtime". Organizes ONLY what the person says into an editable brief: their original words (kept unchanged), matter type, confirmed state and city, dated chronology, people involved by role, evidence checklist, consultation questions, deadlines exactly as the person reported them, and a short redacted outreach summary. Each item is labeled (user_says, user_has, suggestion, unknown). Asks for missing details one or two at a time. Never infers facts, deadlines or the state; flags ID numbers, account numbers and health details and leaves them out of the summary. Stores nothing and sends nothing: to contact a lawyer the person picks, use preview_client_message. action discard drops it. Do NOT use for general legal questions, homework, news or when the person only wants information about the law. This is a listing service, not a lawyer referral service. No lawyer pays for placement or ranking of any kind.

action.description: create (default), update after the person edits anything, preview to show the outreach summary, discard to drop the brief

brief_id.description: The brief_id from an earlier answer, so the same brief is updated

evidence_have.description: Documents or items the person says they have

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD or YYYY-MM, only as the person said it

include_names_in_outreach.description: Default false: other people's names are replaced by their role

objective.description: What the person wants to happen, in their words

state.description: State where the MATTER is. Ask; never guess it from where the person is.

state_confirmed_by_user.description: True only after the person confirmed the state

type.description: Type of legal issue in the person's words, e.g. 'eviction notice', 'unpaid overtime', 'car keeps breaking down'

next_steps.description: Next steps the person wrote. ESQ CoPilot does not add legal steps.

original_statement.description: The person's own first description, word for word. Never rewrite it; pass it back unchanged on every update.

description.description: Optional. Names stay out of the outreach summary unless the person asks to include them.

questions.description: The person's own consultation questions, or the suggested ones after the person edited them

redact.description: Words the person wants left out of the outreach summary

user_reported_deadline.description: A date the PERSON reported (court date, notice period). Not checked or calculated.
